title: natural convection in a vertical slot, conduction regime (Batchelor 1954 parallel flow), EXACT tier

roache_floors.source: scripts/roache_triple.py, imported by name (MESH_STANDARD.md section 10.5, chief ruling 01967a7b); the comparator defines neither and REFUSES if these numbers differ from the import

G1.quantity: v(xi*)/u_ref at mid-height, 4-point Lagrange at xi* = 1/2 - sqrt(3)/6
G1.band_ground: 2.1x the DERIVED fine-level discretisation error 7.031e-04 (exact_t13.discrete_expectation); the coarse (1.125e-02) and medium (2.812e-03) levels are predicted OUTSIDE it

G1b.quantity: xi_max, location of the maximum upflow from the cubic through the 4 cells around it
G1b.band_ground: 2.2x the DERIVED fine-level error 6.765e-05; coarse (1.081e-03) and medium (2.705e-04) predicted OUTSIDE

G2.quantity: RMS over the mid-height row of (T - T_lin)/dT
G2.grading: ABSOLUTE FLOOR (EXACT-class row): a linear T is in the null space of the scheme's truncation error, so its triple is EXACT/DEGENERATE by construction and rule 5 (2) would return NOT A RESULT for a row that cannot be wrong by discretisation; the triple states are PRINTED, the verdict is the floor

G3.quantity: Nu_L = -(dT/dx)_wall L/dT from the half-cell wall gradient, hot and cold walls, mid-height row
G3.floor_ground: the half-cell gradient amplifies a temperature deviation delta by 2N; at N_f = 80 the witness floor 1e-6 on delta gives 1.6e-4; registered 2.0e-4

C_CONV.what: iterative convergence: initial residuals of Uy, T and p_rgh <= 1e-6 at EVERY iteration of the final 10 percent; Ux is a degenerate (~0) channel and is REPORTED, never gated (L-338)

W0.what: y-invariance mirror: the rows just above and just below mid-height agree in v (per u_ref phi_max) and T (per dT) to 1e-6

W1.what: end-effect witness: rows at H/2 +- L, +- 2L, +- 4L agree with the graded row in v (per u_ref phi_max) and T (per dT) to 1e-6; exceeding it means the level is NOT in the parallel-flow regime -> gate (1) NOT A RESULT

C_RA.what: operand identity (L-331): nu, Pr, beta, TRef, g, T_hot, T_cold, L, N are READ FROM THE CASE FILES, printed, and Ra_L recomputed from them must equal 100 to 1e-9

C_ORDER.what: cell-ordering control: the graded row's T must fall monotonically from hot to cold with the registered slope -dT/L to 1e-6 relative; a transposed ordering (y-fastest) shows a constant row and REFUSES

C_PZ.what: planted-zero control per reader (rule 3, L-340 sizing): point plant for G1/G1b/G3/W1, ALL-ROW plant for the RMS reader G2; both arms; measured detection ladder; REFUSES on a blind or noisy reader

predictions.P1: G1 and G1b triples CONVERGING with observed order p in [1.5, 2.5]; derived expectation p = 2.000 / 2.000
predictions.P2: G1 relative deviation at f in [+4.9e-4, +9.1e-4] (the derived +7.03e-4 within 30 percent), POSITIVE sign; c and m OUTSIDE the +-1.5e-3 band
predictions.P2b: xi_max error at f in [-8.8e-5, -4.7e-5] (the derived -6.77e-5 within 30 percent), NEGATIVE sign
predictions.P4: witness W1 < 1e-7 on every level (a priori bound ~1e-9 relative at 8L from the ends)
predictions.P6: all three levels meet C_CONV and C_PLAT within their registered endTime

cost.rate_point_source: K0f C_lam, LAMINAR buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam, MEASURED: ExecutionTime 5564.7 s over 50 176 cells x 40 000 iterations (verification/runs/F14-cooling-ladder/K0f_runs/STATUS.C_lam, C_lam/log.solve)
cost.rate_ceiling_source: T4 level c, kOmegaSST on the same solver, MEASURED (STATUS.T4_IJ_c, C-119)
cost.overhead_floor: C-118: below ~1e3 cells the per-iteration cost is overhead-dominated and linear cell-step scaling over-predicts 2.2-2.4x; the coarsest level here has 6 400 cells, above that regime, and the same over-prediction direction is expected (T4's ratio 0.423 at 5k-83k cells)
cost.usd_basis: derived, not measured, reported-by-owner rate (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER section 5)
cost.rate_scratch_source: MEASURED 2026-08-26T20:52Z on a SCRATCH COPY of T13_VS_c (6 400 cells) run 400 iterations through run_one_t13.sh under the queue runner's setsid/nohup/cd form: ExecutionTime 4.58 s, wall 5 s, rc=0 -> 1.789e-06 core-s per cell-iteration; the scratch copy was outside the repository and no registered case was touched
cost.note: caps are UNCHANGED from the K0f/T4 derivation (ceiling rate); the scratch rate is the POINT estimate that the calibration ledger row compares against (rule 12)

completion.note: capped is an INFRASTRUCTURE field and never a completion conjunct (L-342)
